slides.title: How you win it
slides.question: In Guard Recovery with Passing Resistance Game, what counts as the win?

options.text: On top, locking hands and holding the pin against real resistance
options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

options.text: Holding the finish after your partner taps
options.feedback: Never. Let go the instant your partner taps. Every single time. The tap is law.
You keep the pin by feeling your partner and moving with them, not by clamping down and squeezing hard. Staying calm beats forcing harder.

body.text: Staying with a hard partner on the mat instead of switching is commitment made physical. Staying in a hard relationship when leaving is easier is the same choice. Both build the muscle of not bailing on people.

body.label: Said simply
body.text: Staying is the skill. But leaving a harmful relationship is not failure. This is never an all-or-nothing rule.

reveals.label: Where this sits in The Initiation

content.text: Chest-to-chest contact on the mat is like contact with people. Friction on the mat is like friction with people. A break on the mat is like a rupture between people. A reset on the mat is like repair between people. The Initiation tests the real you against other people.
